_comment: Vinery. On the Apple Press the extract fuel slot and the deposit fuel slot are not the same slot, so the two directions are declared separately.

containers._note: Fermentation Barrel: 0 grape juice, 1-3 ingredients, 4 wine bottle, 5 output

Apple Press: 0 press input, 1 intermediate product, 2 wine bottle input, 3 output. The extract fuel preset takes output slot 3, the deposit fuel preset feeds wine bottle slot 2 (keeping the original semantics)
